scope: Qwen3-235B Public HF Eagle3 NeMo-RL diagnostic runs

public_hf_candidates.notes: Fast path diagnostic. vLLM compatibility still needs runtime confirmation.
More directly aligned with vLLM eagle3 speculative_config. Download completed at 15:21 PDT with model.safetensors present.

specdec_gate.note: This is a long-tail gated NeMo-RL diagnostic, not an always-on standalone acceptance test.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Cancelled after review found the launcher did not pass policy.model_name=${TARGET_MODEL_ID}; the YAML default therefore ran target model Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B while the attached PublicHF drafter was nvidia/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507-Eagle3. This target/drafter mismatch makes acceptance-rate and throughput results non-publishable. The launcher has been patched to pass policy.model_name explicitly, and corrected job 3084952 supersedes this run.

specdec_gate.note: Parallel RedHat public-speculator fallback with the same long-tail gated NeMo-RL shape as the NVIDIA diagnostic.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Failed before any NeMo-RL acceptance/throughput metric. The concrete failure was MegatronPolicyWorker creation: FileNotFoundError for nrl_megatron_ckpts_20260526/Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B/iter_0000000/run_config.yaml after workers printed 'Checkpoint already exists ... Skipping import.' This was a checkpoint-completion race: validate_model_paths treated the iter_0000000 directory as a complete checkpoint even though run_config.yaml was missing. The remote SpecDec-RL patch now treats a Megatron checkpoint as existing only when iter_0000000/run_config.yaml exists.

specdec_gate.note: Corrected PublicHF diagnostic. The launcher now explicitly passes policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, matching the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 drafter family.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Submitted after patching the 235B launchers to pass policy.model_name explicitly and patching Megatron checkpoint-complete detection to require iter_0000000/run_config.yaml. At 17:17 PDT the job was still RUNNING after about 51 minutes. Ray workers were online at 128/128, the driver log confirmed policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 plus the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 speculative_config, vLLM V1 engine initialization with enforce_eager=false and CUDA Graph mode, target safetensors loading to 118/118, and the observed 1/1 drafter safetensors load. The policy-worker venv rebuild finished and lm_policy workers initialized 128/128 in 53.40s. No real NeMo-RL acceptance-rate or throughput metric had been emitted yet; the only acceptance grep hits were redacted env-var lines, not metrics. The latest tail is Megatron policy/checkpoint state loading and distributed-checkpoint warnings, with no traceback or fatal error observed.
